design_notes.motif: abstract descending sparkline, not a literal chart-with-axes — no numeral labels, no plotted axis lines beyond one faint dashed baseline
design_notes.point_mapping: y = 520 - (score - 40) / 30 * 300, x evenly spaced 140..1060 across 8 weekly readings; 100px of headroom left above the 620 baseline so the final point settles rather than touches the floor
design_notes.focal_point: final reading (score 40) at (1060, 520) — deliberately smaller/muted dot + soft halo, calmer than the family's usual bold focal-dot treatment, signaling cooldown rather than alarm
design_notes.opacity_direction: recedes across the series (peak week boldest, latest week quietest) — inverse of the ascending-climb convention, reinforcing the cooling narrative
design_notes.wash_technique: low-opacity dusty-rose ellipse behind the settling zone + low-opacity fill under the polyline, same family technique as gmk-cyl-og-extensions-interest-check.svg's focal ellipse wash
